mapper.select: SELECT i.*,s.code sku_code,p.name product_name FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id WHERE i.order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY i.id

SELECT o.id,o.order_no,o.customer_id,c.name customer_name,o.status,o.channel,o.ordered_at,o.total_amount FROM sales_order o JOIN customer c ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE o.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{suffix}) ORDER BY o.ordered_at DESC,o.id DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT o.id,o.order_no,o.customer_id,o.status,o.ordered_at,o.total_amount,o.remark FROM sales_order o WHERE o.status IN ('PENDING','PAID','SHIPPED') AND o.remark LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') ORDER BY o.ordered_at DESC,o.id DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT o.id,o.order_no,o.status,o.ordered_at,o.total_amount,c.name customer_name,c.phone FROM sales_order o JOIN customer c ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE o.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR o.remark LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR c.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR c.phone LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') ORDER BY o.ordered_at DESC,o.id DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT o.id,o.order_no,o.status,o.ordered_at,o.total_amount,c.name customer_name,c.phone,a.city,a.street FROM sales_order o JOIN customer c ON c.id=o.customer_id JOIN customer_address a ON a.id=o.address_id WHERE o.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR o.remark LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR c.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR c.phone LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR a.street LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') ORDER BY o.total_amount DESC,o.id LIMIT 20

SELECT DISTINCT o.id,o.order_no,o.customer_id,o.status,o.ordered_at,o.total_amount FROM sales_order o JOIN sales_order_item i ON i.order_id=o.id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id WHERE p.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') ORDER BY o.total_amount DESC,o.id LIMIT 50

SELECT o.id,o.order_no,o.status,o.channel,o.ordered_at,o.total_amount,c.name customer_name,a.city,w.name warehouse_name FROM sales_order o JOIN customer c ON c.id=o.customer_id JOIN customer_address a ON a.id=o.address_id JOIN warehouse w ON w.id=o.warehouse_id ORDER BY o.ordered_at DESC,o.id DESC LIMIT #{offset},#{size}

SELECT COUNT(*) order_count FROM sales_order o JOIN customer c ON c.id=o.customer_id JOIN customer_address a ON a.id=o.address_id JOIN warehouse w ON w.id=o.warehouse_id WHERE o.ordered_at>=#{from} AND o.ordered_at<#{until}

SELECT o.id,o.order_no,o.status,o.ordered_at,o.total_amount,MAX(c.name) customer_name,MAX(a.city) city, MAX(w.name) warehouse_name,MAX(p.transaction_no) transaction_no,MAX(sh.tracking_no) tracking_no, COUNT(DISTINCT i.id) line_count,COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) return_count FROM sales_order o JOIN customer c ON c.id=o.customer_id JOIN customer_address a ON a.id=o.address_id JOIN warehouse w ON w.id=o.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN payment p ON p.order_id=o.id LEFT JOIN shipment sh ON sh.order_id=o.id LEFT JOIN sales_order_item i ON i.order_id=o.id LEFT JOIN return_order r ON r.order_id=o.id WHERE o.ordered_at>=#{from} AND o.ordered_at<#{until} GROUP BY o.id,o.order_no,o.status,o.ordered_at,o.total_amount ORDER BY o.ordered_at,o.id

SELECT o.id,o.order_no,o.ordered_at,o.total_amount,o.discount_amount,o.shipping_fee,x.line_count,x.item_amount, x.item_amount-o.discount_amount+o.shipping_fee-o.total_amount difference FROM sales_order o JOIN (SELECT order_id,COUNT(*) line_count,SUM(line_amount) item_amount FROM sales_order_item GROUP BY order_id) x ON x.order_id=o.id WHERE o.customer_id=#{customerId} ORDER BY o.ordered_at DESC,o.id DESC

SELECT o.id,o.order_no,o.customer_id,o.ordered_at,COUNT(*) line_count,SUM(i.quantity) units, SUM(i.discount_amount) discount_amount FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id WHERE i.promotion_code=#{code} AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY o.id,o.order_no,o.customer_id,o.ordered_at ORDER BY o.ordered_at DESC,o.id DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT i.id,o.order_no,o.ordered_at,s.code sku_code,p.name product_name,i.quantity,i.unit_price,i.line_amount FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id ORDER BY i.created_at DESC,i.id DESC LIMIT #{offset},#{size}

WITH RECURSIVE days(d) AS ( SELECT DATE(#{from}) UNION ALL SELECT d+INTERVAL 1 DAY FROM days WHERE d+INTERVAL 1 DAY<DATE(#{until})) SELECT d.d day, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales_order o WHERE DATE(o.ordered_at)=d.d) order_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales_order o WHERE DATE(o.paid_at)=d.d) paid_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales_order o WHERE o.status='CANCELLED' AND DATE(o.ordered_at)=d.d) cancelled_count FROM days d ORDER BY d.d

SELECT o.id order_id,MAX(o.order_no) order_no,MAX(o.ordered_at) ordered_at,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue, SUM(s.cost*i.quantity) cost,SUM(i.line_amount-s.cost*i.quantity) margin FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id GROUP BY o.id HAVING MAX(o.customer_id)=#{customerId} ORDER BY ordered_at DESC,order_id DESC

SELECT o.id,o.order_no,o.customer_id,o.ordered_at,o.total_amount, (SELECT AVG(x.total_amount) FROM sales_order x WHERE x.customer_id=o.customer_id) customer_average FROM sales_order o WHERE o.ordered_at>=#{from} AND o.ordered_at<#{until} AND o.total_amount>#{ratio}*(SELECT AVG(x.total_amount) FROM sales_order x WHERE x.customer_id=o.customer_id) ORDER BY o.ordered_at,o.id

SELECT o.id,o.order_no,o.ordered_at,o.status,o.total_amount, (SELECT SUM(x.total_amount) FROM sales_order x WHERE x.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND x.ordered_at>=#{from} AND x.ordered_at<=o.ordered_at) cumulative_amount FROM sales_order o WHERE o.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND o.ordered_at>=#{from} AND o.ordered_at<#{until} ORDER BY o.ordered_at,o.id
